title: Disney Mickey Mouse ALL OVER Faces Ceramic Large Plate Homegoods Tjmaxx
descriptionText: This large ceramic plate features the iconic Disney character, Mickey Mouse, with an all-over print of his face. The plate is perfect for any Disney fan and is a great addition to any collection of housewares or dinnerware. Made by Homegoods and Tjmaxx, this plate is sure to be a high-quality addition to your kitchen or dining room. The brand of the plate is Disney and the character/story/theme is Mickey Mouse, making it a must-have for any Disneyana collector.
